drawingPresent.description: True when the source sheet declared a drawing part, even one with no anchors (empty `<xdr:wsDr/>`). Round-trip only: keeps the part, its relationship, and its content-type override alive through a round-trip.

drawingRid.description: Drawing reference r:id. Round-trip only: drawing parts the bridge cannot map onto options (e.g. OLE shape representations) pass through verbatim; fresh worksheets derive the reference from images/charts/shapes.

groups.description: Anchored groups (xdr:grpSp): group transform + nested children.

ignoredErrors.description: Ignored errors — suppress specific Excel error checks for cell ranges

legacyDrawingHF.description: Legacy drawing for header/footer r:id. Round-trip only: the referenced VML part is not re-emitted by the compiler.

legacyDrawingRid.description: Legacy drawing reference r:id. Round-trip only, same passthrough semantics as drawingRid.

preserveEmptyTableParts.description: Preserve an empty `<tableParts count="0"/>` container; round-trip only — do not hand-author.

protectedRanges.description: Named protected ranges within this sheet

shapes.description: Anchored shapes (xdr:sp): geometry + optional text body.

sheetId.description: Workbook sheet id — unique but not necessarily sequential.

sheetViewsPresent.description: True when the source sheet declared `<sheetViews>`. Round-trip only: distinguishes an omitted element from fresh authoring defaults.

singleXmlCells.description: Single-cell XML tables on this sheet (xl/tables/tableSingleCellsN.xml)

uid.description: Revision UID; preserved when the source emitted it.

uidPrefix.description: Root uid attribute namespace prefix when the source spelled it with a revision-prefixed binding (`xr2:`/`xr3:`/`xr6:`) — round-trip only; the writer defaults to `xr:`.

WorksheetSmartArtOptions.description: SmartArt anchored in the sheet. The four diagram parts travel as passthrough parts; their package-absolute paths (as resolved from the source drawing rels) wire the frame to them — passthrough paths never move, so they stay valid verbatim.

creationId.description: a16:creationId `@id` from the cNvPr/docPr extension list — Office's per-object creation stamp, the sole known cNvPr ext content.

hidden.description: XSD `@hidden` (default false); emitted as "1" only when true.

toCol.description: To cell column (1-based) for twoCellAnchor. Defaults to col + 1.

toRow.description: To cell row (1-based) for twoCellAnchor. Defaults to row + 1.

creationId.description: a16:creationId `@id` from the cNvPr/docPr extension list — Office's per-object creation stamp, the sole known cNvPr ext content.

elementName.description: Source graphic-data child spelling; `webextensionref` by default.

fallback.description: Snapshot picture used by the mc:Fallback branch.

hidden.description: XSD `@hidden` (default false); emitted as "1" only when true.

part.description: Parsed webextension part content — round-trip only.

snapshotSourcePath.description: Fallback snapshot image path; round-trip only.

toCol.description: To cell column (1-based) for twoCellAnchor. Defaults to col + 1.

toRow.description: To cell row (1-based) for twoCellAnchor. Defaults to row + 1.

XYAdjustHandle.description: XY adjust handle. Allows the user to drag a handle in X/Y directions.

XmlCellPropertiesOptions.description: Cell properties of a single-cell XML table.

XmlColumnPropertiesOptions.description: Table column XML mapping — lives on table columns, not this part.
